name: request_flight_reconfirmation
description: Log a flight-reconfirmation request for an in-house guest: the concierge calls the carrier and rings the guest's room with the result. Collect ALL the flight details first and read the booking reference back before calling - a wrong reference makes the whole request useless.

flight_number.description: Airline code and number as given (e.g. "IB 6174").
flight_number.title: Flight Number

flight_date.description: Flight date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format. When the caller says a weekday ("Thursday"), resolve it against today and say the concrete date back ("Thursday - that's June eleventh?") BEFORE calling; a one-day slip sends the whole request to the wrong flight.
flight_date.title: Flight Date

booking_reference.description: The airline booking reference, letters and digits only.
booking_reference.title: Booking Reference

seat_check.description: True if the guest also wants their seat assignment checked - it's handled in the same carrier call.
seat_check.title: Seat Check
